reviewer: Policy subagent, separate from experiment-runner implementation author
review_scope: Read-only code and test review of controlled development factorial design and failure handling
independence_limit: Internal agent peer review, not an outside audit or controls-engineer approval. Reviewer authored the static guidance constants being tested.
conclusion: No blocking defect found for the registered bounded development experiment after the listed revisions. This does not validate model capability or future experimental results.

findings.prior_issue: All provider_response failures interrupted the experiment, including invalid generated JSON and truncated content.
findings.resolution: provider_failure_requires_stop preserves scored failures when a response hash and expected reported alias are present. Preparation, missing delivered response, HTTP, scope, and model-identity failures stop. Explicit stop-rule wording and a targeted distinction test are present.

findings.prior_issue: The initial gate did not require all eight refusal-control guard cases before cloud calls.
findings.resolution: Before provider preparation, the runner requires baseline success, refusal control overall failure, exactly 0/10 useful assessments, and 8/8 correct guards.
Tests now exercise source drift before credential access and setup failure leaving an interrupted receipt without a completed comparison.
findings.limits: This review inspected test definitions. It did not independently rerun tests or inject a live service failure.

findings.resolution: Read-completion and offline finding/check diagnostics must be attached for every arm before stage 4 is reported complete. They are not yet computed by the runner summary itself.
All-case latency includes guard cases and possibly withheld attempts. Report useful-case and accepted-advisory latency separately when interpreting results.

verified_by_code_inspection: Preregistration hash, full design, and source hashes are checked before credential loading.
Every usable arm/case is exported immediately before assessment; captured times are not renewed.
Arm order rotates by case index and process-data pairing is checked against the baseline.
Four provider instances each enforce 61 maximum completion attempts including warmup, for 244 total.
Runtime validator, source boundaries, and authored case expectations remain separate from optional prompt guidance.
Final source hashes are compared with registration and invalid comparisons are marked explicitly.
Expected case labels are not passed into provider messages by the runner.
limits: One pass over a reused development set, not statistical efficacy evidence or a holdout.
Cloud alias is mutable and rotating order cannot eliminate service drift or prompt-cache differences.
Source drift is detected after the run, not prevented by file isolation.
Local preregistration and hash chains are receipts, not external timestamp attestation.
The live evaluation was in progress during this review; no outcome claim is made.
